results.title: Canny's billing plans | Canny Help Center
results.snippet: You can move to the current Free plan from the Billing page in your general settings. While basic API operations, such as creating posts, are supported, custom fields cannot be included on post creation if you're on the Free plan. There is no option to pay for a single function if the plan doesn't include it. The only exception to this is the Business plan, which is custom-priced and includes select optional add-ons.
